answer: Sybil defense leverages microeconomic capital allocation, where non-refundable attestation fees and compounding opportunity costs form an escalating marginal cost curve, blocking adversaries that wander the network to spawn fake nodes. By enforcing staking collateral, slashing penalties, and zero-knowledge verifiable delay, the protocol stops every attempt to forge fake agents, neutralizing each isolated mesa of influence. These primitives yield negative expected attack utility, forcing rational agents into a robust Nash equilibrium favoring capital preservation.
